subtitle: Strength and weight loss at 46: chair exercises with and without dumbbells, standing exercises and plenty of walking.
safety: Check with the doctor before starting, especially with joint pain or any other health concerns.
Use a sturdy chair without wheels or arms, pushed against a wall so it cannot slide.
Strength training matters most: muscle and bone are lost faster after 40, and lifting slows that down. Add 1 to 2 kg when the top of the rep range feels easy.
Form before weight. Breathe out as you lift; never hold your breath.
Stay cool: train in a cool, airy room, wear light layers and keep cold water nearby.
If any exercise causes leaking or heaviness low in the pelvis, make it easier, keep up the Kegels and ask the doctor about a pelvic floor physiotherapist.
Stop for sharp joint pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness. Call for an ambulance for chest pain or pressure, fainting, sudden weakness or trouble speaking.
Sleep 7 to 8 hours; poor sleep makes weight loss much harder.

days.name: Mon
days.note: Works: thighs, glutes, hips, calves, core and pelvic floor.

tiles.title: Seated leg work
tiles.tip: Sit tall near the front of the chair, feet flat. Rest 30 to 45 sec between sets.

moves.name: Seated warm-up
moves.tip: March the feet, roll the shoulders and circle the arms.

moves.name: Seated leg extension
moves.tip: Straighten one knee, hold 2 sec, lower slowly.

moves.name: Seated knee lift
moves.tip: Lift the knee towards the chest without leaning back.

moves.name: Pillow squeeze
moves.tip: Squeeze a cushion between the knees for 3 sec. Works the inner thighs.

moves.name: Pelvic floor (Kegels)
moves.tip: Sit tall and squeeze as if stopping the flow of urine, then relax fully. Do these every day.

tiles.title: Seated dumbbell legs
tiles.tip: Pick a weight where the last 2 reps are hard but clean. Breathe out as you lift.

moves.name: Sit-to-stand with dumbbell
moves.tip: Hold one dumbbell at the chest. Stand up without using the hands, sit down slowly.
moves.q: goblet sit to stand chair dumbbell

moves.name: Seated dumbbell calf raise
moves.tip: Dumbbells resting on the knees, lift the heels high.

moves.name: Seated weighted knee lift
moves.tip: Hold a dumbbell on top of the thigh near the knee.

moves.name: Seated dumbbell twist
moves.tip: Hold one dumbbell with both hands and turn from the waist.

tiles.title: Standing legs and glutes
tiles.tip: Keep the chair in front of you to hold for balance. Rest 45 to 60 sec between sets.

moves.name: Chair-supported reverse lunge
moves.tip: Step back, lower the back knee towards the floor.

moves.name: Sumo squat
moves.tip: Wide stance, toes out. Hold a dumbbell when it gets easy.

moves.name: Standing side leg raise
moves.tip: Hold the chair, lift the leg out to the side, toes forward.
moves.q: standing side leg raise holding chair

moves.name: Standing glute kickback
moves.tip: Hold the chair, push the leg straight back without arching the back.

moves.name: Cool-down stretch
moves.tip: Hold each stretch for 20 to 30 sec: thighs, hamstrings, hips, chest and shoulders. Hold the chair for balance.

tiles.title: Steps
tiles.tip: The easiest way to burn extra calories.

moves.name: Walk
moves.tip: A 10-minute walk after each meal also helps blood sugar and appetite.
